explanation: MHA reference: 32 q/kv heads, head_dim 80 (hidden 2560 / 32), full attention. DynamicCache stores K and V of shape [B, kv_heads, T, head_dim] in float32 (layer 0: 2048 tokens); matches 2 * n_kv_heads * head_dim * 4 * T exactly.

GQA reference: 14 q heads / 2 kv heads, head_dim 64 (explicit in config). DynamicCache stores K and V of shape [B, kv_heads, T, head_dim] in float32 (layer 0: 2048 tokens); matches 2 * n_kv_heads * head_dim * 4 * T exactly.

sliding-window GQA: all layers windowed, W=4096 (config sliding_window; no layer_types). T=4352 > W so the window saturates. transformers 5.x DynamicSlidingWindowLayer keeps W-1=4095 of the 4352 seen positions (T>W saturated); analytic assumes min(T,W)=4096. The window is enforced in the cache itself (truncation), not only by masking.

window+global hybrid (layer pattern [sliding, full], period 2), W=128, T=2048 > W; MoE experts 32 -> 8 (routing only, no KV effect). sliding layer 0 stores W-1=127 of 2048 positions (truncated), full layer 1 stores T=2048; analytic uses min(T,W)=128 for layer 0 and T for layer 1.

MLA: kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64; 2 layers kept = layer 0 (dense MLP, first_k_dense_replace=1) + 1 MoE layer; routed experts 64 -> 8 (no KV effect). transformers caches the COMPRESSED latent per layer: keys [B,1,T,512] (kv_lora_rank) + values [B,1,T,64] (rope part) = 576 elems/token/layer = kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim; no decompressed K/V is materialised in the cache.

hybrid mamba2+attention: attention at layer idx 5, 15, 25, 35 -> period 10 (9 mamba2 + 1 GQA-attention layer kept). mamba2 layers hold constant state: conv_states [B,4352,4] (d_inner + 2*n_groups*d_state = 4352 channels) + recurrent_states [B,64,64,128] = n_heads*d_head*d_state (exact); attention layer 5 stores [B,8,T,64] K/V in float32 (exact). The 0.56% gap is conv-state padding: analytic uses the theoretical minimum 3 stored inputs per channel, HF allocates all 4 conv columns (+156672 B over 9 mamba layers).

pure recurrent (Mamba-1 SSM); state is T-independent, T=512 suffices. conv_states [B,5120,4] + recurrent_states [B,5120,16] in float32, both independent of T. The >1% gap is conv-state padding: the analytic minimum keeps 3 stored inputs per channel, HF allocates the full d_conv=4 kernel columns (+5120 x 4 B = 20480 B).
